data.body:
[P2] Establish coverage for the new event subscription

No related tests accompany this workflow. Existing caller tests enumerate other workflows, and `test-parser.yml` does not include this file in its trigger paths. Removing or changing this event selection therefore leaves those tests unaffected even if notifications stop. This violates rule 4, **Every branch has a test that fails without it**, and AGENTS.md’s related-test requirement. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and establish the acceptance cases and coverage needed to detect broken event routing.
